instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL NATIVEWIND: Run 'yarn add nativewind tailwindcss react-native-svg' immediately.
SETUP TAILWIND: Create tailwind.config.js with the colors defined in 'theme'.
USE LUCIDE ICONS: Use 'lucide-react-native' for all icons (e.g., <Trophy size={24} color='#00C853' />).
DARK MODE ONLY: Force dark mode in the app. Do not implement light mode toggles.
DATA PERSISTENCE: Create a 'storage.js' utility using AsyncStorage for saving teams and tactics.
FONTS: Use 'expo-font' to load Barlow Condensed (headings) and Inter (body).
NO WEB SHADCN: Do not use '@radix-ui' or web-based shadcn components. Build simple RN components using the design tokens provided.
